translations.web: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
translations.bsb: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
translations.kjv: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
translations.asv: And let him turn away from evil, and do good; Let him seek peace, and pursue it.
